course_info.trial_description:
You may have asked yourself whether there is some effective method that can make you speak English fluently, efficiently, and with confidence.
Well, there is such a method!
With my English Conversation Dialogues, you can immerse yourself in real English conversations that tell an authentic story through a variety of dialogues. Each lesson builds upon the narrative by featuring short, genuine exchanges between native English speakers in both formal and informal settings. You will find conversations between close friends, coworkers, family members, classmates, and strangers that will help prepare you to speak English in the real world.
Along the way, you'll also find several situational scenarios from daily life to improve your English language ability. These include picking up prescriptions at the pharmacy, checking out books from the library, and ordering food at a restaurant.
Each dialogue has been written and edited by native English speakers, so you can be sure that you are getting the most natural English grammar, vocabulary, and phrases.
Each lesson also comes with comprehension questions to test your understanding of the story and the English used. No drills or grammatical exercises are necessary to learn English!
my language learning method focuses on the power of extensive reading and listening to achieve fluency.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
I like to teach languages through stories because I believe that fun, meaningful and most importantly, interesting material helps grasp the different language skills much better. Comprehensible input and contexualizing the learning material is what I mostly focus on. 

For example: if we read a very short story about a group of friends traveling to France, we will learn travel-related words (vocab), the future tense (grammar) and talk about our own future travels plans (speaking), etc. 

This allows for a very natural immersion and acquisition of the different language skills.

pro_course_detail.title: General French (pronunciation, conjugation, grammar, vocabulary from beginner to advanced students
pro_course_detail.description:
usually begin a lesson with introductions, so that we both feel more comfortable, less intimidated by each other, and have more spontaneous topics to talk about.
To continue, I make you speak as much as possible to identify your strengths and weaknesses and assess your level.
Then, I adapt my teaching practice to your needs and wishes:
- You are a complete beginner who wants to discover and learn French --> I will guide you through the basics, provide you various materials, and adapt the learning rhythm to your personality and abilities.
- You learned French a while ago, feel a bit rusty about it, and want to find your way back into it --> I will support you with an alternation of conversation practice and grammar review.
- You want to keep practicing daily conversation --> I will come up with some interesting topics to talk about while correcting your mistakes on the chat.
- You feel like you need to work on some specifics (a tense, a grammar rule, the phonetics...) --> I will give you resources and exercises that will teach you how to avoid these mistakes.
- You want your children to learn French, to prepare some homework for school or just to keep practicing and improving a language they already grasp while living in France for example --> I have a lot of experience with kids ranging from the age of 4 to young adults and being beginners or fluent because of an expatriation in a French speaking country. 
- Anything in particular? (Train for a test, prepare for a trip, review basic points before a job interview ...) --> Just ask, and I'll prepare the tailor-made class you need!
